english_source_note: Re0 Calculus 2: The Number e and Fast Computation
callout_id: Re0微积分2:自然底数e及其快速计算#13
statement_en: From the definition, we easily see that $$R_N=\sum_{n>N}\frac{1}{n!}.$$ We then claim that, for sufficiently large $N$, there exist constants $C_1,C_2$ such that $$C_1\frac{1}{N!N}\leq R_N\leq C_2\frac{1}{N!N},$$ denoted by $$R_N = \Theta\left(\frac{1}{N!N}\right).$$
callout_body: 从定义上不难发现$$R_N=\sum_{n>N}\frac{1}{n!}$$那么我们断言，当$N$足够大的时候，存在常数$C_1,C_2$使得$$C_1\frac{1}{N!N}\leq R_N\leq C_2\frac{1}{N!N}$$记作$$R_N = \Theta\left(\frac{1}{N!N}\right)$$
